column1: # B071 probe corpus - enum conversion and enum-member verdicts, LIVE game.
# Trackmania + Openplanet 1.29.14 (next, Public, 6fd4200f), RemoteBuild 127.0.0.1:30000,
# 2026-09-01. Stamp read from Openplanet.log by
# the machine, never typed by a human (B148).
# Generated by scripts/probe_enum_conversion.py.
# THE GENERATOR OWNS ONLY game_verdict AND game_message. `lsp_today` is
# THIS REPO's behaviour at commit a586825 (pre-fix master) and is carried
# forward verbatim -- it is a fact about our history, not about Openplanet,
# and it is the evidence B071 was opened on.
# ROW 3 IS PRESERVED, NOT RE-RUN. It records a measurement that turned out
# to be INVALID (the fixture used a non-existent enum value). Deleting it
# would hide that the corpus was once wrong, which is the most transferable
# thing in this file.
# METHOD. One fixture, one plugin, one compilation unit (B068). Controls of
# both polarities ran in the same session.
# --- HAND-WRITTEN NOTES BELOW ARE PRESERVED ACROSS REGENERATIONS (B148) ---
# See README.md for the ACCEPT-vs-REJECT asymmetry before using any row.
# METHOD. Every row was compiled as its OWN plugin (one fixture, one unit).
#   Never batched: B068 showed that one parse error in a batched unit makes
#   every other name in that unit read as ACCEPTED. A batched run of this
#   corpus would have reported rows 3-7 as clean.
# CONTROLS, run in the same session as the samples:
#   r0  enum LocalOne{X}; LocalOne a = LocalOne::X;   -> CLEAN  (oracle accepts)
#   rX  ZZZNoSuchType q;                              -> ERR    (oracle rejects)
#   Both behaved. An oracle that cannot fail proves nothing about the rows.
# CONFOUND FOUND AND CLEARED. The first pass used
# `EDummyCollectionIdent::Undefined`, which DOES NOT EXIST in the live game;
# rows 1, 3 and 6 carried a stray "No matching symbol" as a result. That is
# harmless for a REJECT row (an error appeared, and an error is
# self-evidencing) and FATAL for row 4, whose conclusion is drawn from the
# ABSENCE of an error. Row 4 was therefore re-measured three ways, including
# an anti-vacuity guard (r2s) proving the fixture reaches the typechecker at
# all, and with VirtualKey::A - a value already recorded as a live ACCEPT in
# b053-bare-enum-values.tsv, rather than a guessed one.
# lsp_today: MEASURED, not inherited. openplanet-lsp release binary built from
#   a586825 (a verified ancestor of master) run as `openplanet-lsp check` in
#   each fixture dir, 2026-08-31. Two anti-vacuity signals in the same run:
#   the rX control returned rc=1 `unknown type ZZZNoSuchType`, and rows 2 and 8
#   emitted `an enum value ... is never used` warnings. So the analyser
#   demonstrably reads these files and can report on them; the silence below is
#   specifically the absence of a mismatch diagnostic, not the absence of
#   analysis. Every mismatch row exited rc=0 with no error.
# READING THIS TABLE.
#   Rows 4 and 5 CLOSE a line of work: enum -> int is legal and the LSP's
#   silence is correct. Do not implement a diagnostic for it.
#   Rows 1, 2, 6, 7, 8 are five real missing diagnostics.
#   Row 3 is retained deliberately. Deleting a measurement that turned out to
#   be invalid hides the fact that the corpus was once wrong, and the reason
#   it was wrong is the most transferable thing in this file.
# WORDING. Match the engine's own text in any new diagnostic
# ("Can't implicitly convert from 'A' to 'B'.", "No matching symbol 'E::V'"),
# so a user searching an error string finds both tools.
# AFTER THE FIX (lane/enum, B071, 2026-08-31). The `lsp_today` column above is
# left exactly as measured on pre-fix master (a586825) — overwriting it would
# erase the evidence the ticket was opened on. This block is the re-measurement
# on the branch, same method: one fixture per row, `openplanet-lsp check
# --typedb-dir tests/fixtures/typedb`, controls in the same run.
#   row 1  engine cross-enum   -> error: Can't implicitly convert from 'VirtualKey' to 'UI::MouseButton'
#   row 2  workspace cross     -> error: Can't implicitly convert from 'LocalOne' to 'LocalTwo'
#   row 4  enum -> int (ws)    -> silent   (UNCHANGED, and required to stay so)
#   row 5  enum -> int (eng)   -> silent   (UNCHANGED, and required to stay so)
#   row 6  int -> enum         -> error: Can't implicitly convert from 'int' to 'LocalOne'
#   row 7  bad member, engine  -> error: No matching symbol 'VirtualKey::NoSuchValueZZZ'
#   row 8  bad member, ws      -> error: No matching symbol 'LocalOne::NoSuchValueZZZ'
# Row 1 uses VirtualKey/UI::MouseButton rather than the ticket's
# EDummyCollectionIdent/EGhostNameLogoType: the two Nadeo enums are absent from
# the repo's FIXTURE typedb, so a test naming them would assert silence from a
# path that never ran. Same axis, two engine enums, resolvable in the harness.
# Controls in the same run, both discriminating: a trivially valid fixture
# returned rc=0 clean, and `ZZZNoSuchType q;` returned rc=1
# `unknown type ZZZNoSuchType`.
# ALSO MEASURED, and required to stay silent — neither is in the table above
# because neither is a conversion, and both are engine ACCEPTs a naive fix
# breaks: cross-enum ARITHMETIC (`LocalOne::X + LocalTwo::Y`) and OR-ing an
# engine flag enum into an int. Both live in the acceptance fixture in
# tests/b071_enum_type_mismatch.rs alongside the six errors.
# FALSE-POSITIVE SWEEP. Base (f75dc89) and branch binaries were run over 151
# real plugins in ~/src/openplanet/my-plugins. First pass: ONE new diagnostic,
# and it was wrong — `tm-editor-plus-plus` declares `enum Axis` and writes
# `Axis(c)`, which resolved to the Core enum `UI::Plot::Axis` by short-name
# rescue. Fixed at the resolution site (the plugin's own declaration wins) and
# pinned by a test. Second pass: zero delta across all 151.
